newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds untraded because of Thanksgiving.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds untraded because of Thanksgiving.

text.p: Argentine bonds were not traded Thursday as the market remained motionless on account of the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday.
Not more than five trades were recorded on screens and those were unrepresentative of any real market move, said traders.
"The market was inactive," said one of the few traders at his desk.
The dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 closed Wednesday at 121.10, while Argentina's FRB due 2005 was flat at 85-6/8. The FRB was unchanged in London trade as well.
